hero.kicker: For students and past pupils. Over 18s only.
hero.title: Your foot in the door
hero.body: Once you've left school, a network starts to really count. You might be looking for an internship, or just someone to read your CV and tell you honestly whether a job is worth going for.
hero.body2: That's what contacts do for people who have them, and this is where you get yours. Once you're signed in you can see the contact details mentors have chosen to share and get in touch with them yourself. It's just between you and the mentor, nobody else is copied in.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.body: Use the link your school sent you and this will fill itself in. Make sure you use the same email address the link was sent to.
signup.email_hint: Use an email you'll still have in three years, not your school one, as those get switched off.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: We'll email you a link that signs you in, so there's no password to remember.

directory.title: The directory
directory.body: Browse mentors by industry. Where a mentor has agreed to it, you'll see their contact details and can get in touch with them directly.

routes.title: How to join
routes.body: You can join if you're 18 or over and you go to, or went to, a school that's registered with us. Your school approves you, not us.
routes.student_body: Ask your guidance counsellor. Once you've turned 18 they can send you a link, and that's all you need.
routes.past_body: Get in touch with your old school and ask them to send you a link. It doesn't matter what year you left.
routes.nothing_body: Email us and let us know which school you went to, and we'll reach out to them. It carries a lot of weight with a school when one of their own past pupils is asking.
